description: This file defines the 'DisplayField' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_display_field' database table. It models display field data with properties like 'id', 'className', and a collection of associated 'SelectedDisplayField' instances, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a display field in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for ID, class name, and associated selected display fields, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with this display field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name associated with this display field.
